SVAD 499.description: Supervised experience in a professional environment within the fields of visual art, design, and media. Undergraduate internship contract required with approval of instructor, advisor, and department head before registration.
SVAD 499.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in ARTS 246 for Art Studio B.F.A. majors in the Graphic Design and Illustration concentration; no prerequisite for other majors.
SVAD 499.subject: SVAD
SVAD 499.title: School of Visual Art and Design Internship

SVAD 550.description: A faculty-led, student-run, digital and print design agency that will provide experiential learning opportunities, foster beyond the classroom engagement, and bring community visibility to the work of students who will create design solutions for real clients in the community.
SVAD 550.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in ARTS 345 and ARTS 347; students must also submit an application to be approved to take this course.
SVAD 550.subject: SVAD
SVAD 550.title: Design Studio
